title: artifact: fix unnamed orphans on re-pull
body:
- Vendor container-libs libartifact (TODO: Proper vendoring)
- Add E2E coverage for re-pull + `artifact ls` / `rm` by tag and by digest ref.
- Document the behavior in the pull/rm man pages and release notes.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28033
Related: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29658
Depends on: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1265

```release-note
Fixed a bug where re-pulling an OCI artifact whose remote tag had moved left the previous local manifest unnamed, which broke `podman artifact ls` and `podman artifact rm`. Re-pull now renames the previous manifest to a digest reference (`repository@sha256:<digest>`). Very old broken artifact stores may lose unnamed entries on first open ([#28033](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28033)).
```
